dogecoin.text: Anybody who talks to me seriously about Dogecoin as a investment into your future we need to quit talking at that moment. We don't think the same..

But for some reason he keep talking about Dogecoin and it hitting .014c meanwhile ETH is on a hell of a run. People see penny stocks and think poop I can load up and get rich... Not realizing penny stocks are volatile and will smack right back down to nothing in no time
